avoid: Don't pitch the sales team; the DACH roles are not our angle.
rationale: Jane Example owns the platform and the open platform roles, but the shared inbox is the only published route.
summary: Katana publishes no personal address for its CTO, so the letter goes to hello@ addressed to Jane Example and asks to be forwarded. Two follow-ups add the hiring signal and then close the loop. Any reply, bounce or opt-out ends the sequence.

touches.ask: Worth a 15-minute look at how we would take load off the platform team?
touches.talking_points: The Series B extension means more customers on the same platform; we add capacity without new hires.

touches.ask: Could you point me to whoever owns platform hiring?
touches.talking_points: The open Senior Platform Engineer role shows the gap; we cover it while the hire is found.

touches.ask: Should I close this for now?
touches.talking_points: Short close; leave the door open.
